sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) orders) SELECT * FROM recent r JOIN (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $2) c ON c.id = r.customer_id, generate_series(1, 2), (SELECT 1 AS one)
